response.rationale: Cellular neurothekeoma best fits the dermal nested/fascicular epithelioid-spindle morphology, collagenous stroma, S100 negativity, vimentin positivity, and lack of melanin/epidermal melanocytic proliferation. The focal Melan-A/HMB-45 positivity is atypical, but the other candidates require architectural or immunophenotypic features that are not provided or are contradicted.

rejected.why: No smooth-muscle immunophenotype is supplied, and the nested epithelioid morphology plus Melan-A/HMB-45 positivity are not characteristic of leiomyosarcoma.
DFSP would require storiform/honeycomb infiltration and usually CD34 positivity; the epithelioid nested morphology and melanocytic marker expression are discordant.
Bednar tumor requires melanin-pigmented dendritic cells, but the vignette explicitly states there was no intracytoplasmic melanin pigment.
Plexiform fibrohistiocytic tumor would require plexiform architecture and giant cells; age, site, and melanocytic marker expression are atypical.
